newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Scania Q1 heavy truck market share falls.
newsitem.headline: Scania Q1 heavy truck market share falls.

text.p: Swedish truck maker Scania on Thursday said its market share for heavy trucks in West Europe fell to 16.1 percent from 16.6 percent in the first quarter.

The group said in a statement of first quarter results that the fall in its market share came amid lower registrations of trucks in Western Europe due to lower order bookings in the last part of 1996.
"The Western European market shrank by 20 percent compared with the first quarter of 1996 and was at approximately the same level as during the fourth quarter of last year," Scania said.
"Scania's market share in Western Europe was 16.1 percent (16.6). Scania's share for 1996 as a whole was 15.5 percent," the group added.
